title: Oppo Introduces Pad Mini With OLED Screen and Snapdragon Chip
excerpt: Oppo has launched the Pad Mini, featuring an 8.8-inch OLED display, a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor, and an 8,000mAh battery.
body_html:
Oppo has officially announced its latest tablet, the Pad Mini. Designed to compete in the compact tablet market, the new device comes equipped with a number of high-end hardware specifications.

Key Specifications

  • Display: 8.8-inch OLED screen
  • Processor: Snapdragon 8 Gen 5
  • Battery: 8,000mAh capacity

The Pad Mini aims to offer flagship-level performance in a smaller form factor, pairing a sharp OLED display with a powerful processor and a large battery to support extended daily use.
